Bland food, cold service - AVOID
Jul 2025 • Solo
Service: Disappointing
Dined here last week and was underwhelmed by the service. Despite being virtually empty, staff barely acknowledged us. No warm greeting, no guidance on the simple menu—just cold, rushed interactions. Felt like a dine-in chore rather than a welcome experience. The waitress who is also the owner is very rude and curt. 

Food: I tried three things:
 1. Vegan Bánh Mì – online praise aside, this was stale and soggy. The filling was limp tofu and pickles, lacking any crispy crunch or vibrant flavor. Tasted under-seasoned and unimpressive.
 2. Spring Rolls – they arrived cold and lukewarm, with wilted rice paper and a thin smear of filling. No fresh herbs, no crispness—basically soggy tofu rolls 
 3. Coconut Ice Cream – icy and grainy, tastes like what I imagine dirt tastes like

Service was actively unfriendly, food was dull across the board, and the “all-vegan” label felt more like a gimmick. With so many genuinely flavorful vegan spots in HCMC, Nâunâu just didn’t measure up—flavorless, forgettable, and not worth the visit.

This is the best banh mi and kombucha I ever tried
Jun 2025 • Solo
The best banh mi I ever had, the vegan mushroom pate is amazing with the soy mayo makes a perfectly delicious balance with the tofu sausage. And they make everything by them self. Everything feels so healthy and very hygienic. Oh and the kombucha, also homemade and 3 flavours is to die for. Crazy delicious and refreshing, they have passion fruit, hibiscus, and ginger, I tried all 3 and loved them all. 
And the staff is so nice and smiling. The menu is modern (no food waste), not to many dishes and they have new daily dishes every day, I tried the banh hoi he, crazy good! I just love this place. So happy that I found food and quality in this level.

Cute Place and Good Food
Dec 2023 • Couples
We visited this place for lunch and had a really good Vegan Vietnamese Food. The google maps does not take you to the exact place, you are 100-200 meters away so have to ask around as it is located in an alley. The owners didn't speak much of English but menu has been listed in English also so its not a problem. Food is super tasty and I was very glad that we tried this place. The spiciness of the food just elevated my taste buds, if you are not okay with chillies you can tell them "No Chillies". Also tried their Vietnamese Coffee which was okay. The seating is limited but very cutely arranged & decorated. Met couple of other travellers there and had a really hearty conversations.
